name: Boccali Ranch Pumpkin Patch
description: Boccali Ranch Pumpkin Patch is an agritourism farm in 277 E. Ojai Ave, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
